name: One-arm dumbbell row
summary: One hand on a bench, row a dumbbell to the hip with the other, elbow close to the body.
setup: Place one hand and knee on a bench, back flat, dumbbell in the free hand, working arm nearest the phone. Row the weight to the hip with the elbow driving back, then lower fully.
brief: Place one hand and knee on a bench, back flat, dumbbell in the free hand. Row the weight to the hip with the elbow driving back, then lower fully.
why: From the side the elbow angle closes each rep, so reps are counted. The trunk twisting to help is listed, not judged.
tempo: Up 1 s, squeeze 1 s, down 2 s.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Trunk twisting to lift
faults.tip: The chest stays facing the floor; the arm does the work.

faults.label: Twisting the trunk to lift
faults.tip: Rotating the body to finish the rep means the weight is too heavy.

faults.label: Not reaching the hip
faults.tip: Finish with the elbow behind the body.

faults.label: Elbow flaring out
faults.tip: Draw the elbow back along the body rather than out to the side.

points.t: Elbow drives back past the ribs.
